roles.title: Asst. Director — Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Model Governance & Independent Review
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement; ~$50bn cumulative) — independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Operate within a formal model-governance framework: assess model risk by validating assumption defensibility, escalating outputs lacking mathematical or economic support, and maintaining documentation standards aligned with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.
Serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders on remediation plans.

sections.heading: Model Development & Validation
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — embedded behavioral assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays; validated outputs throughout the build.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation — confirmed sensitivity consistency and scenario impact integrity at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.
Oversaw interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks.

Migrated manual spreadsheet valuation workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines; ran both environments in parallel for two production cycles to confirm output reconciliation before cutover — governance audit closed satisfactorily.

sections.heading: Tooling & Efficiency
bullets: Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating first-pass code review, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reducing development cycle time by an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules while preserving human sign-off on governance-critical steps.

Led onboarding and platform implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform — validated model outputs post-deployment and translated client investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner requests.
Successfully migrated all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant — IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — contributed to governance documentation, regulatory-readiness processes, and cross-functional alignment across actuarial, finance, IT, and risk teams.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments for Canadian and international pension-fund clients.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization using VaR and CVaR via Ortec's GLASS platform — with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk attribution, and near-optimal frontier analysis.

Delivered ALM studies analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk; conducted cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency exposures.

Led the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger (new jointly-sponsored plan) — on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics, evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented ALM findings and strategic asset allocation recommendations to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.
